artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the ordered-prime criterion through 10^6 and the two-prime classification on 431,568 parameter triples.
Deterministic output of the bounded checks, including zero mismatches in both tests.

limitations: The primitive classification uses the Bailey--Smyth closure definition of primitive Novák solutions. The counting lower bound concerns primitive Novák numbers with exactly two distinct prime factors, not all primitive solutions. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; older work and general recurrence self-divisibility results remain residual risks.
provenance: Scientific sources and proof evidence are documented in RESULT.md and the dated independent-audit files.
record_title: Ordered-prime construction for Novák numbers and primitive two-prime infinitude
scientific_context: A Novák number has a canonical increasing-prime construction; the local prefix condition gives a two-prime classification and an infinite primitive family.
